text:
How excess reduction applies could be clearer

This is the first time I have used InsureandGo. I will be better informed next time and save on the policy cost by not selecting 0 excess option, which only applies to select items.

Snowed in

Very easy to set up. Great communication from consultant. Very happy with outcomes. I would definitely recommend insure and go to anyone else who is seeking travel insurance in the near future.

Hopeless customer service. They will delay all claims as long ad possible and try to wriggle out of paying.

Used them once,claims process was a nightmare. Will never use them again. Kept asking for more information at every contacr. Staff unhelpful and quoted?policy? as the reason for their unwillingness to pay amount claimed.

Inflexible and unreasonable

Booking online was easy and the premium was reasonable. However, when I needed to extend my policy they were not helpful. My original policy was valid thru 27 May, which was the date I was leaving LA. I had to change my trip at the last minute on 26 May to leave on 01 June instead. However,the phone line for TID was only open for 4 hours on Sunday and they were already closed after making the booking. I called on 27 May from the US to extend my coverage, but they would not because it was 28 May in Australia and my policy had expired according to their date. I was given the excuse of "the computer won't let me renew it". I was told I would have to buy a new policy and was only offered 10% off. When I asked for a larger discount since it was still 27 May by my local time, I was told "10% is the only discount available on their computer." They should have been more reasonable considering the time zone and date difference, and considering that I couldn't even call when I first changed my flight since they were only open 4 hours on Sunday. Decent price, easy to book online. Poor customer service availability on weekends, inflexible and unwilling to consider my circumstances

Satisfied travel insurance

I was happy with Allianz Travel Insurance as they would cover myself with a pre-existing medical condition. I felt secure that I was traveling overseas with appropriate & 100% cover. I didn't have to make any claims. The policy was easy to set up - I spoke to a Allianz personnel over the phone who asked me questions. I will be using Allianz again for my next overseas holiday.

Didn't use it

However I noticed when the email with insurance details came thru one of the names in our party was wrong. We were unable to change this after calling? Was promised updated email with name corrected however that didn't come thru. Can't complain about product.

Never again - Horrible service and didn't insure us

I would never again use Cover more for my travel insurance afte I'd misplaced my backpack containing my laptop which had all my photos from my trip. Cover-more not only took well over there supposed 10days heading more toward 2months where I waited for them to turn around and say they weren't covering me. 2 months without replacing my laptop as I was advised on my 5th phone call to them to wait before replacing it. I run a business where I was unable to do half of what I needed to due to no access to a computer. Horrible service as I had to keep calling them to find out what's happening and waiting an entire 2months or more for a response.

Two separate bad experiences - Insurers will weasel out of everything if they can

I have a Bank credit card overseas travel policy which is underwritten by Allianz; hence any claims are made on Allianz. I have made two separate claims: 1. My mother suddenly fell ill after booking a holiday and declined over about 6 months and then died. The illness was related to a pre-existing condition but the Doctor confirmed in writing that my mother was not expected to suddenly decline and die. Allianz rejected the claim on the basis that it was a pre-existing condition; life is a pre-existing condition! This was 2 years ago. The warning is that they will use anything like this to avoid a payout. 2. We booked a (very expensive!) overseas trip and had to cancel because of COVID border closures. The booking was before COVID was declared a pandemic. Allianz declined travel insurance as they only cover defined events and this was not defined. Again, beware of these sort of things before you buy their insurance. The lesson for me is to be very careful about choosing travel insurance products. Allianz has many 'get out of jail clauses' but others may be just as had as well.

Good

I've used this company just once. I think I might consider it for my future traveling. The only thing that I didn't like was their delayed response to my emails.

I rated allianz OK as I didn't need to make a claim

BUT after reading the reviews it really scares me. I trusted the words written in the fine print but praise Jesus we are OK, safe, well and home. I feel sad for these people if you take out insurance you should be able make your claim without difficulty if you have genuine proof !!!

Wrong time to send me a feedback survey! I just got back from Bali!

As I have just experienced being in Bali whilst the airport closed during volcano activity probably not a good time to ask me to survey your service. I know I wasn't covered for natural disaster at the time, however I wanted to be sure I was covered for unrelated expenses and medical. Email response was very slow, staff responses very generic with no empathy shown. I needed to extend my policy as was not sure when I would be leaving on a flight. Phone response when contacting your emergency team to extend my policy for an unknown time frame was very aloof and scripted and also because I didn't catch his name correctly very rude! I was calling him [name removed] instead of [name removed]! I was told in no uncertain terms that the policy would only extended once at a cost of course! And after that expired I would not be insured! Not knowing if my next flight would be cancelled I took the chance and extended to that date. Luck was with me and I flew out on that flight. If I hadn't I would have been in Bali with no travel insurance. I find this most unacceptable not to be able to pay and extend for what ever period anyone is stranded with no option of leaving your travel destination. Insure and go were the only business I had no help from whilst being unable to fly out from Bali. I had superb service from Flight Centre and Perth Airport who showed empathy, sympathy and excellent and continuous communication through the whole stressful ordeal. Shame on you Insure and Go! I will not be insuring with your company again for any of my travels. Your lucky I even gave you Two stars! Read less

Good

The product and the experience was fine - didn't make a claim, but setting it up was pretty straight forward. The real test of course is making a claim. Lucky it wasn't required.

Unprofessional

Happy to take your money but poor service when you put in a claim. Claim poorly managed and then denied on nit-picking detail.

Pre-exisiting condition

The policy was a good value unless you have a medical condition. despite the fact I have a kidney organ transplant for the last 17 years and the condition has been stable. In the view of my doctor - it will last a long time. Why am I being punished by having to pay high premium for a condition that is very stable and is most unlikely to affect my health while travelling. Total Discrimination if you have a medical condition.

A must have for any cruise

I thought it was good value ,easy to set up ,clear and simple easy to find on the internet compared better than other quotes i had reviewed all good there

Excellent cover

I was most impressed by the Policy for an over 80's traveller. and particularly that I received a text message, asking if I wished to expend my cover two days before it was due to expire.

Still not worth paper it's written on...

just received a renewal notice this morning! I still haven't gotten over the lack of service provided by 1Cover... Read the unsatisfied reviews... small and reasonable claims denied! $549 worth of useless insurance, and I only wanted to claim a pair of reading glasses!!!

Contact impossible

I took out a policy in July 2019 for an extensive trip commencing 1/6/2020. This trip itinerary and bookings were undertaken personally and of course I then had to dismantle the bookings and managed to obtain a number of refunds. Three providers would not come to the party and so I lodged a claim on line 24/6 and a claim officer was appointed 10/7. To date I have heard nothing so rang and finally got through to a call centre 15/7 and was told I would hear from my case manager "[name removed]" with 48 hours. To date nothing so rang today but no joy. I have asked for a supervisor to ring and explain the position. I am concerned about the comments I am reading on this site about difficulties dealing with this company. It amazes me they are still offering excuses when they have had several months to redeploy staff and provide training to handle claims.

Insurance cover

I was recommended by a friend that has used you for some time, thankfully I have not need to claim from you so all is good, the only trouble was this time I had to ring after a few weeks as I hadn't received my card to take with me, but all if fine otherwise.

Well Priced Service

1Cover is well priced and to date I have never had to make a claim. I've been using 1Cover since 2009 and most recently used them for domestic travel to cover the car rental excess, a far cheaper option. On booking this latest travel insurance I recommended a friend to use 1Cover and as a reward received a $20 e-gift card. A nice treat, thank you 1Cover! Only downfall to 1Cover is discovering they won't cover family emergencies once a family member is over 85 years of age. It seems from now on I will have to search for non budget insurance to cover any overseas travel.

Sounds good until you claim or ring to confirm a quote

Three times, claimed once with a negative outcome. Also rang to change a date of policy prior to paying only to find that the policy was totally changed from gold cruise to gold - meaning that we were not covered if we were on a cruise which was the only thing we were doing.

Make sure you check evrything and don't trust the TID consultant to have common sense.

I took out a policy with TID that covered my holiday ,after it was all booked, 2 months before leaving.I rang back later about a common complaint I have had very occaisonally (PVC's) that are harmless but they said I needed to change to pre-existing medical which I then did .Somehow the period covered by my policy was changed by one day,I have both policies one which says 24th to 14th and the new one which says 25th to 14th .The missing day made no difference to cost and wouldn't you think the consultant changing my policy would say "Excuse me Mr ** why are you saying your holiday now starts on the 25th instead of the 24th as your other policy shows" But No. Of couse I never realised the change and as fate would have it I had a claim on the only day in 3 weeks I wasn't covered. Be Aware there is No Fair Play or Honest Mistake's entertained by TID even if you think their consultant would be half awake to mention you have changed a date accidently.(If I did say it) Anyway my kids/nephews/friends are now travelling and I have sold quite a few TID policies for them but the last few trips I have changed my advice to them. No discretion applied for plain as day honest mistake .

6 months later..

The service was great whilst I was overseas and needed to get home. However, claiming with them was nothing but a nightmare! I spent a lot of time calling asking where my money was and dealing with rude people. 2 of them yelled at me and others were nicer. I had to submit my claim over 6 times and I was given my money back in parts over 6 months. Lots of money was deducted out of my overall claim and when I tried to make a formal complaint I couldn't even get a hold of them. Clearly covermore was trying to drag this out so I would get tired of trying to chase my money and forget about it, but I persisted and finally got most of it. Since this incident I've heard many similar stories about them. Nothing but disgusted with the service now and I would never book with them again.

It?s travel insurance

It was easy enough to get the insurance. They seem quite intent on being reviewed but it?s difficult to review something that was purchased but not used. Reviews need to come from people who have actually made claims.

Great value travel insurance

Good value, easy to start policy and enough email correspondence to keep any traveller updated I've used this company several and each time easy to use. I've never claimed but I'm hoping it would be as smooth as signing up.

Good cover. Straight foward claim process.

Easy on-line set-up, good value cover. Customer support was good. On-line claim and subsequent support very efficient (iPhone destroyed in swimming pool). Money in the bank in 2 weeks. Have to be happy with that.

Great prices

I found online to be quick and easy and very good prices and great value for money and I will definitely recommend Allianz to all my family and friends .

Expensive 3 days in Wellington, NZ

My review deals more with the process of submitting a claim. Not easy to submit a claim until you have all the information required. Can't save as you go along. Can't talk to anyone - call diverted to call centre in Asia. Never spoke to anyone at InsureandGo despite supplying email and telephone number despite several attempts. A decision takes 4 weeks and a review of the decision takes another 2 weeks. My husband fell ill in Wellington, NZ and I decided to come home and seek medical help rather than be given a large bill in NZ which I was told we would have after attending the Emergency Dept at Wellington Hospital. He was diagnosed with chronic bronchitis and allergic reaction by a medical practitioner in Australia after the 3 and half hour trip back to the Gold Coast from Wellington. As we didn't get a medical certificate in NZ our claim for curtailment of our journey was rejected. Secretive mob with no intention of providing cover for what we paid. Won't use them again.

Great Cover Great Price

Was very happy with level of coverage and price of policy!!!! As I didn't need to use it, that's all I can say. Based on above would use Allianz again.

No cover for corona virus unlike other insurance - has a cut-off date

Was hoping that they might reconsider as the policy was purchased mid last year way before this epidemic in China. Other insurance providers states that they will cover as long as policy was purchased before Jan 23, 2020 or some even Jan 30, 2020. Please read the fine print - not the kind of insurance that will help when needed most in this scenario. Was going to travel to other parts of ASIA with no ?do not travel? warning from DFAT yet still no cover for the coronavirus as it is considered an epidemic in China even though not yet a pandemic as per WHO for now. So please be careful when purchasing travel insurance.

Too Hard to claim

Went on a cruise so took out policy with TID. I was mugged in Barcelona and had gold necklace stolen which was given to me on my 21st, 30 years ago. I did everything that was expected, spent hours at a Barcelona police station and made the necessary statement, had markings on neck photographed. Went to make the claim and it seems all they are interested in is the receipt and proof of purchase. I have explained that I cannot get a receipt as this was 30 yrs ago and the person that bought it for me was now living somewhere in the Phillipines and not contactable. I am know told a stat dec will do, however it will only be and estimate of what it cost. This has now been going on for the last 6 weeks and they are still insisting on a proof of purchase and price from 30yrs ago. I am happy to do what ever is necessary to provide what they need, knowing what the replacement cost is likely to be, however I have now been informed that this claim will only cover $700! I have checked the PDS and it very miss guiding as in the spread sheet it list coverage of $6000 and $3000 but in reality the claim is only good for $700. I will never use TID again as I feel absolutely scammed by the usual ?small print garbage?. Why can?t it just do what is says on the packet!! ****************************************** UPDATE 8 Months on and they have, up until recently insisted on the receipt from 30yrs ago. I have now sent a stat dec, a jewellers quote and 2 photos of me wearing the necklace, 1 from 1989 ish and the other from 2015. Fingers crossed that that this gets it over the line. Oh and the fact that the company?s customer service person reached out to me in an email obviously made absolutely no difference what so ever. This has been absolute joke and extremely painful.

too much drama to claim unless for a large claim.

tried to claim for loss of stolen money,bank cards,,unless for a big claim ,too much paper work.if you want to claim make sure you have kept all receipts for everything you might want to claim for even then they will probably want more .

Worst example of travel insurance-avoid!!

My partner and I were on a 8 night cruise holiday in NZ of which we had enjoyed 1 night of, when we had word that his father had died suddenly, we had to disembark the ship, make our own way back to Australia booking our own accommodation/flights. The cruise ship company would not offer any reimbursement or credit but luckily we had travel insurance or so we thought, Allianz have been appalling to deal with, we supplied the death certificate, that was not enough, they then asked for 12 months of medical history from his GP which was then supplied and now they want the records from the ambulance and cardiologist. We give them what they ask for and they keep demanding more. I have accepted we will not be getting any reimbursement from them but if I can advise anyone else looking for travel insurance not to go with these crooks, I will be happy.

READ THE FINE PRINT!!!

We arranged cover in November 2017 for a planned trip in May 2018. We completed the full disclosure and were accepted without exclusions. In April 2018 just 4 weeks before we were due to travel I was diagnosed with bladder cancer Fortunately it was superficial and was removed. The specialist issued a letter to say this and that I was fit to travel. We contacted InsureandGo to advise them of the change in circumstances and they tried to push us towards cancellation of our trip however to do this we had to obtain a letter from a doctor to say that I was not fit to travel. A contradiction of the letter I sent them already. Next we were told that if we travelled we would have bladder cancer excluded or we had to pay a 400% increased premium. Next they told us that all pre-existing conditions we disclosed would be excluded including my wife who was not associated with this illness. They have now agreed that they will provide some level of cover excluding bladder cancer or anything that may be associated with it. We took the cover at the time of booking our holiday in case there was a change of circumstances however it seems that this is just an opportunity for InsureandGo to reassess their risk and impose a huge increase in premium. If the doctor had advised against travel we would not have considered travel however this was not the case. May 6th 2018 Update: Read the fine print We asked the Sales Team Leader at InsureandGo to review the decision to exclude the recent illness I had suffered, which was 6 months after we arranged our policy and just a few weeks before we are due to travel. My specialist has advised in writing that I am fir to travel otherwise we would not go. The response was " We have the right to change the conditions of your policy in line with the change of risk. Your newly declared bladder cancer does represent a change of risk and the system determined that the risk equated to a medical premium of $2,185.05because with cancer there is always a possibility of relapse or associated issues" Note it was the system that determined the extra premium and no consideration is given by a medically qualified person that there is very limited risk. The simple solution is to try and extort a 400% extra premium or simply tell us that this part of the policy no longer applies. InsureandGo are aware that we are not able to arrange insurance with another provider, particularly at this late notice and it is just a way of extracting a huge premium increase. When you arrange your cover do not assume that you are protected because if your circumstances change you could end up without any cover at all by the time you go on holidays or could end up with thousands of dollars in increased premium. WHAT A JOKE! May 9th 2018 Update: Read The Fine Print Dear Sales Team Leader ([name removed]) Well there you go. Despite the letter from the specialist urologist that I provided in the hope that you would see reason, it is obvious that you and/or your company is "bloody minded" and arrogant. You are clearly of the opinion that you know more that the Specialist Urologist who for the record has just provided another letter that I sent to you saying "he has superficial bladder cancer which had been adequately treated and cured but his ongoing treatment involves Mitomycin medications instilled in his bladder (now completed). This treatment is only precautionary and in no way implies that he still has bladder cancer. His cancer has been adequately treated and eradicated and the precaution treatment of Mitomycin should not affect his insurance as it is not an essential treatment but an optional precautionary treatment only. In addition the treatment will not result in any side effects that should affect his travel" Your options you provided us in response to this are: 1. We accept your exclusion for bladder cancer "and anything related', as deemed by your company 2. We pay the extortion fee of $2185.05 for us to have the cover we arranged in November 2017 reinstated 3. We go elsewhere (with just 5 days before we are due to travel) June 10th 2018 Update: Read the small print Insureandgo put us through hell before we left on our holiday. Arranged cover in November 2017. Am unexpected medical incident occurred in April 2018 and we notified Insureandgo. 1 month before we were due to leave they suggested we cancel or pay an extra $2,700 in premium (400% increase) or exclude anything related even though the specialist issued a letter to say I was cured and fit to travel. Insureandgo refused to accept the specialist advice. We went without cover for any related event although we had major concerns on how any claim would be treated based on their inflexible approach to this matter. Fortunately nothing occurred however we will never use them again nor will many of my friends as they too were of the view that once cover was arranged then any change in circumstance would be covered and not seen as an opportunity to extort a huge increase in premium.

Disappointing end to a great trip!

We carefully researched and chose what we believed was a "Gold Cover" and were left sorely disappointed when our flight was delayed and Insure and Go refused our claim for prepaid Accommodation and an Excursion that we were unable to complete. Be careful as we along with our Travel Agent thought this was a valid claim but apparently not with Insure and Go.

No fuss insurance

I booked the family holiday oversea's. I had a heart bypass last year. ( all good) . A friend recommended cover more ins . 3 days before we are to leave my 10 year old daughter jumps off a tree stump at school and breaks her leg. Re -booked our holiday 3 months later . Claimed the insurance , no fuss at all . No hidden clauses ,very happy with cover more insurance. Affordable insurance. You cannot travel with your family with out insurance. Peace of mind.

Good but no service is perfect

I&G travel insurance are good value and have a good range of cover. I've suffered from cancer, it is not fair to pay an extra premium even though I am 100% clear.

Unhappy customer - even before the travel

Cover more was recommended by my cruise P&O. I took the policy and the staff was good. Things nose dived when I called back today to make a small change to the "excess" for my insurance. The call centre staff sounded very arrogant ( 29th April around 5:20pm) my original plan had $100 excess and just wanted to change it to $0 excess by paying the difference. As per the agent that was not possible and I will need to cancel the whole policy first plus I will need to make FULL payment for a full new policy and then wait another 3 to 5 working days for the refund of my first policy , which I find very inconvenient and not a very customer friendly policy by cover more. If the staff was curtious and polite in explaining this, I would still have taken the new policy. Just for making a small change in excess if cover-more is making this much fuss , God forbid, I wonder how it will be in an event of claim .. I hope management takes this feedback constructively. Thanks PV- Auckland, New Zealand.

Very happy with cover --

Will certainly use you for future travel insurance--Although we didn't make a claim we felt the premiums were far better than most as was the cover.Very helpful in setting up the policy for our travel needs ! Thanks .

Read EVERY word of the policy and check EVERY detail with the Company before agreeing to their terms

Once. We made a claim which was denied due to a technicality which was not appreciated by the Insurance Company.

I have not received any confirmation of purchase.

I have not received any information or confirmation of my purchase, nor information about how to make any possible claim. could you please email me with this data?Thanking you, Christopher Bishop

recent claim for travel insurance recinded due to health concerns and refunds

I have used this insurance company many times over the last decade and is usually my first call for insurance travel quote.

So far so good.

Initially when I purchased my insurance with Insureandgo I made a mistake on the form. The staff were very helpful in sorting everything out for me. The insurance premium seems to be much cheaper than with other companies. In the event we do have to claim I hope the service is as good.

Try making a claim

Yes very easy to obtain travel insurance but I hope you don't have to make a claim like we did, my wife is going through cancer treatment and I thought I would send her back to Brazil to say hi to her family and whilst in Brazil she was robbed. When she returned we claimed for the stolen camera and 7 weeks later the investigations team has now finished and it will be a further 10 days to see if our claim is accepted. They have spent 3 times the value of our camera investigating, what a waste of resources, we are very disappointed with allianze travel insurance and don't recommend them stay clear. I have just cancelled house insurance contents and car insurance with allianze and gone with a VERY REPUTABLE INSURER RAC YES RAC AND THEY ARE CHEAPER

No Issues

Policy was good value, very easy to set up and although it was not required, I will utilise in the future and trust the claims are as efficient as the rest of the process. The only insurance policy to date that has reminded us of our holiday with some travel tips and welcomed us back. Maybe computer generated but still way in front of any other company we have used.

My medical claim with COVER MOORE

I was very happy with the trouble free outcome of my claim it provided excellent value. The policy was easy to set up with guidance and advice from my travel agent. I received all requested support from the provider on application and finialation of my claim for Tavel insurance

Easy to arrange and comforting to have

The policy for us was a good comparative value. I had no problem setting up the policy online. We did not need to make a claim so there was no contact required. I did receive update emails. Unless you have to make a claim it's hard too know what sort of support you would get.

Buyers of Travel Insurance Beware

My wife and I took out Travel Insurance with 1 Cover in November 2017 for travel to Mauritius in May 2018. However, on my day of departure Air Mauritius cancelled my departure flight and re scheduled it for the next day. As I had paid for breakfast and dinner at a resort in Mauritius my wife and I were out of pocket for one nights accommodation and food. I made a claim to Air Mauritus and stated that I had a $200.00 excess with my travel insurer but they denied any liability. A similar claim was made to 1 Cover and documents from my Travel Agent and Air Mauritius were submitted, however , they rejected my claim on the grounds that as per their PDS, cancellation claims relating to operational problems were not covered. The claim was for $300.00 less $200,00 Excess. Buyers beware.

Need it didnt use it

Knowing that we had this affordable insurance was there , made the holiday a holiday if something goes wrong were covered.Being able to do all the activities we wanted to do.

Easy to arrange online

The policies we have taken out have all been good value. Extremely easy to arrange online. We have lodged a claim after a previous trip we made during 2018 and it did drag on for quite a while which we were not too happy with at that time. We have purchased about 10 policies through Insure and Go including 2 separate ones only yesterday for a short domestic trip and also for Bali. One of the previous policies we arranged in early 2018 for a 12 month period including a lengthy overseas holiday.

Covers Care at Home

We used them twice now and the insurance has covered our adult disabled daughter and her carer at home while we have been away. It has meant having some break time. Also easy to set up and good value. Thankyou

Simple to purchase

Quite easy to purchase and simple to list pre-existing illnesses. Premiums seem to be value for money compared to other companies

Hard to review 1Cover Travel Insurance .

Well , We take travel insurance [ like all insurance ] for ' What may happen ! ' Exactly, how many times I've taken 1Cover insurance for South East Asia trips , I couldn't tell you [ maybe 20+] , luckily I've travelled some 30,000 ks on my motorbike ,in 3 countries and avoided any mishaps , so I can't write about how 1Cover perform [ say for a urgent medical evacuation ] Maybe they'll discount my next policy - for all the $ they've never had to pay out on ? Lol , joking of course .

Left me stranded without cover

Tried to extend my policy the day before it expired. The 1cover system responded with errors after multiple submissions to extend. Credit card has no issues. Emailed them, was provided a different quote that was $62 _more_ than I was quoted online. Long story short, after over 15 emails back and forth over the day trying to pay them (they all went home once their work day was over so I had no response for hours), the clocked ticked over and I was left without cover. Fully aware of what had happened, 1cover then offered me a 'Residents Already Overseas' policy for $200 more than the original online extension quote, with a 7 day waiting period, and told me now there was nothing they could! Yes, really. I bought a new policy with World Nomads instead. I can't imagine how I'd be treated if I had to make a claim. Buyer beware.

It was great and easy to apply for.

I was very happy with the policy and it was very easy to set up. I would refer it to my friends and family

Easy to use

Four times easy to claim but a bit slow to receive the payment. Poor communication re the claim. But a good product. Nice to feel covered.

Purchased a policy that's now worthless & no hint of a refund/credit.

I purchased a travel insurance policy as a repeat customer from Insure & Go in November 2019 for travel to Italy in July/August 2020 well before the current pandemic. Due to COVID19 travel restrictions I'm unable to use it. Insure & Go have refused to refund or even credit even though I will not be making any claims on the policy. Disgraceful behaviour & in my opinion theft as a service or product was not provided. The excuse provided was the time is now outside of the 14 day cooling off period.....I'm not buying a f%$&ing house!! Will never purchase from them again & would NOT recommend this company.

Not yet put to the test

Allianz Travel insurance is attractively priced and I have used it several times but as (fortunately) I have never had to make a claim I have no idea how they respond when it actually counts.

Unexpected costs.. I'll ask better questions next time!!

we took out full cover for our USA trip recently. Due to a pre-existing health problem (it's never been a problem though) we ended up paying over $600. I made a claim upon our return for lost glasses and a cracked mobile phone. I gave all documentation and emailed the claim off. I received a txt two days later to say it was received, and to expect 10 days.. ok... I received a call to say my claim had been settled and I'll see this in my chosen account. I was shocked to see it was less than half of what I expected and I had 2 lots of excess taken. It was one claim.... the word 'Event' is not disclosed anywhere as 'separate' and this really annoyed me as it meant only the screen was covered. on my certificate is clearly say Excess $100, not $100 per item claimed. My glasses had a depreciation of 55% and then the $100, which meant I could somehow buy a new frame and lens for $25. please tell me where???? so angry about 2x$100 just because it was two items. The holiday and insurance was one. i didn't take out separate insurance for each holiday stop, so why the separate excess. Never again!!!. I tried to contact them today, 35 mins on hold.. sorry but that's really bad in my eyes not good customer service. Online for everything you need excess not clear, bad customer service, on hold for 35 mins.

Breaking own policies!!!!

Thought when I lodged my claim it would be simple! Water damaged phone on holidays in Thailand. I provided all documentation and waited out my 10 business day outcome. I call at 1pm on the 10th business day to be told they havent looked at it yet but someone will get to you today before 8pm. Already disgusted i called at 645pm to see if I should start replacing my phone to hear a recording to call between business hours! I have not had a phone or been contactable by work friends or family for two weeks now!! This is unacceptable after purchasing comprehensive cover!!

Cannot travel without!

Cannot travel without Covermore Travel Insurance their excellent service from time of cover submitted on the internet to actually being in a position to having to make a claim was a good experience for me. Claimed on internet with relevant claim form to getting details required for cover was thorough & well handled with a good business attitude. Thank you Cover-more for your excellent service. Efficient and attention to detail good.

Have always used and recommended Insureandgo UNTIL i had a claim now wouldn't use again or reccomend

Have always used Insureandgo for any overseas trips for myself and our family and two cruises beforehand and have never had a problem UNTIL we needed to make a claim. We have made a claim after missed ports, delayed ports, cancellation of our tours and lost mobile phone and had to contact them several times after not hearing back for over a month only to be told our "case worker was away sick so that's what was holding it up" ????
